title: 三方合并：同一区域并行修改 -> 冲突（反例对照）
expected_output:

  -- merge 输出 --
    <<<<<<< HEAD

    =======
    timeout = 90

  ours  : ['retries = 3', 'mode = safe']
  theirs: ['timeout = 60', 'retries = 3', 'mode = safe']
  -- merge 输出 --

  theirs: ['timeout = 30', 'retries = 3', 'mode = fast']

    mode = fast

code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""冲突的充要条件：相对共同祖先 base，ours 与 theirs 改动了**同一区域且结果不同**。
本例给三组对照：同区域异值 -> 冲突；同区域同值 -> 自动合并；删 vs 改 -> 冲突。"""
import difflib


def hunks(base, side):
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=base, b=side, autojunk=False)
    return [(i1, i2, side[j1:j2]) for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes() if tag != "equal"]


def merge3(base, ours, theirs, label_ours="HEAD", label_theirs="theirs"):
    h = [(label_ours,) + x for x in hunks(base, ours)] + [(label_theirs,) + x for x in hunks(base, theirs)]
    h.sort(key=lambda t: (t[1], t[2]))
    out, pos, i, conflicts = [], 0, 0, 0
    while i < len(h):
        j = i
        end = h[i][2]
        while j + 1 < len(h) and h[j + 1][1] <= end:
            j += 1
            end = max(end, h[j][2])
        cluster = h[i:j + 1]
        out.extend(base[pos:min(cluster[0][1], len(base))])
        groups = {}
        for c in cluster:
            groups.setdefault(c[0], []).append(c)
        if len(groups) > 1:
            reps = {k: [y for c in v for y in c[3]] for k, v in groups.items()}
            if len(set(tuple(r) for r in reps.values())) == 1:
                out.extend(next(iter(reps.values())))
            else:
                conflicts += 1
                out.append("<<<<<<< " + label_ours)
                out.extend(reps.get(label_ours, []))
                out.append("=======")
                out.extend(reps.get(label_theirs, []))
                out.append(">>>>>>> " + label_theirs)
        else:
            for c in cluster:
                out.extend(c[3])
        pos = max(pos, end)
        i = j + 1
    out.extend(base[pos:])
    return out, conflicts


BASE = ["timeout = 30", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"]

CASES = [
    ("同一行改成不同值 -> 冲突", ["timeout = 60", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"],
     ["timeout = 90", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"]),
    ("同一行改成相同值 -> 自动合并", ["timeout = 60", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"],
     ["timeout = 60", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"]),
    ("一侧删除、另一侧修改同一行 -> 冲突", ["retries = 3", "mode = safe"],
     ["timeout = 60", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"]),
    ("不同行各自修改 -> 自动合并", ["timeout = 60", "retries = 3", "mode = safe"],
     ["timeout = 30", "retries = 3", "mode = fast"]),
]

for idx, (desc, ours, theirs) in enumerate(CASES, 1):
    print("=== 用例 %d：%s ===" % (idx, desc))
    print("  ours  : %s" % ours)
    print("  theirs: %s" % theirs)
    merged, conflicts = merge3(BASE, ours, theirs)
    print("  -- merge 输出 --")
    for line in merged:
        print("    " + line)
    print("  冲突数: %d   自动合并成功: %s" % (conflicts, conflicts == 0))
    print()

print("结论: 冲突判定只看『同一区域内 ours 与 theirs 的结果是否一致』，与『改了几个文件』无关")
